claims.text: The COMPAS recidivism risk assessment software is no more accurate at predicting recidivism than predictions made by people with little or no criminal justice expertise.
The COMPAS recidivism risk assessment software is no more fair in its predictions than predictions made by people with little or no criminal justice expertise.
A simple linear predictor using only two features performs nearly equivalently to COMPAS with its 137 features.

evidence.description: We show, however, that the widely used commercial risk assessment software COMPAS is no more accurate or fair than predictions made by people with little or no criminal justice expertise.
We show, however, that the widely used commercial risk assessment software COMPAS is no more accurate or fair than predictions made by people with little or no criminal justice expertise.
We further show that a simple linear predictor provided with only two features is nearly equivalent to COMPAS with its 137 features.

methodologies.name: Recidivism Prediction Model Comparison
methodologies.description: Compared the accuracy and fairness of COMPAS risk assessment software against non-expert human predictions and a two-feature linear model.
conditions: Predictions by people with little or no criminal justice expertise

limitations.text: Existing commercial software like COMPAS uses 137 features without achieving better accuracy or lower bias than human non-experts or simple linear models.
